verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual says a private key can be generated inside the app and attached to your Identity. Keys can live on the Secure Enclave behind Face ID/Touch ID, and the public key can be auto-registered with GitHub/BitBucket. Self-hosted Linux/BSD/Synology servers are reached over SSH, so key-based, password-less server access is covered for Git use. Missing for 10: details on key types/algorithms and exporting the public key to arbitrary servers, evidence of SSH use beyond Git (e.g., shell login), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
